detectors.description:
Reentrancy in LendingVault._pull(IERC20,address,uint256) (src/LendingVault.sol#311-315):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- token.safeTransferFrom(from,address(this),amount) (src/LendingVault.sol#313)
	Balance read before the call:
	- beforeBalance = token.balanceOf(address(this)) (src/LendingVault.sol#312)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- token.balanceOf(address(this)) != beforeBalance + amount (src/LendingVault.sol#314)
		- stale variable `beforeBalance`
